overall_assessment: The Track 07 governed screening workflow implements the structural skeleton of a rigorous systematic-review screening protocol. However, methodological adherence is undermined by three critical gaps: the audit trail is not truly append-only for canonical decisions, role assignment is unauthenticated, and blinding is bypassable through direct data access.

findings.description: Canonical decisions are mutable and deletable despite an append-only history. amend_decision overwrites existing decisions, and rescreen_subject removes prior decisions entirely.
findings.recommendation: Make decisions values immutable once recorded.

findings.description: Role assignment and revocation are unauthenticated public methods with no authorization boundary.
findings.recommendation: Require an authenticated authority token for assign_role/revoke_role.

findings.description: Blinding is a voluntary projection, not an enforced access control.
findings.recommendation: Separate the blinded projection surface from the raw state.

findings.description: Agent authority in the screening board is decoupled from the agent workflow authority gate.
findings.recommendation: Integrate the authority evaluator into the screening board.

findings.description: Decision binding to eligibility criteria versions is nominal, not enforced.
findings.recommendation: Require evidence excerpts for every exclusion; validate eligibility_version against known protocol versions.

findings.description: No built-in inter-rater reliability metrics are provided.
The adjudication rule is unvalidated free text.
PolicyAdmin role can amend individual screening decisions, conflating protocol administration with decision modification.
Agent exclusion confirmation does not validate that the human independently applied the same eligibility criteria.
findings.recommendation: Require distinct rationale or evidence reference in human confirmation.

calibration_notes: Methodologists will broadly agree on the criticality of blinding bypasses, mutable canonical state, and unauthenticated role assignment.
